title: Luna's Fluffy Day: drawn by hand
kaylee: Luna's salon looks like the rest of new Peru: Luna, Paco and Abuela Killa now have Tika's face and soft flat wool, in a hand-drawn highland meadow. She plays it exactly as before.
questions: Luna, Paco and Abuela Killa all wear Tika's face now. Family, or too alike?

pictures.title: Brushing Luna
pictures.caption: Every generated picture is gone: the meadow, the tools, the basket and the things in her fleece are drawn by hand
